notes.title: Store Page Revealed! We'll be seeing you at MAGFest 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43317329/2187f190da5ded7f98c4d91cc9b81a4d2474d46f.jpg[/img]
Yo! It's about time we have a store page for this game.  The trailer we have right now is only temporary, and we'll definitely have something more awesome in the future to hype you guys up. We're at the point where a lot of the main systems we need are now working, so we can actually spend a lot of our time making the chapters that brings the whole game together. To show you guys what progress we've made so far, we will be appearing the MAGFest Indie Video Game Showcase on January 5-8, 2023. Please come by and eat a snack with us. We're also bringing some Hazuki merch, so if you want to take a cute Hazuki with you, come drop by.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43317329/0fda8206d19de18e9816220262dcafe1a34aca85.jpg[/img]

We also have a Itch.io page of Hazuki Dies: 
[url=https://chairgtables.itch.io/hazuki-dies]https://chairgtables.itch.io/hazuki-dies[/url]

But you know, if you wishlist the game on Steam, we'll reveal a new VTuber model for the main developer and have it debut during our speedrun at Awesome Games Done Quick in January 12. We'll be seeing you there too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43317329/a5ed8e9fe1f4326bf86a56f06e224056b817af09.jpg[/img]
